findings.title: The L1-06 generic-credential-assignment hit is a symbol-only run (false positive); L1-06 also misses key-named credential fields (1 sandbox update_password argument, runs-3 banking)
findings.evidence: 1 string at /tacit_secure_output (runs-4 claude-sonnet-4-tacit workspace pre-pass IT8); the same value occurs in 4 logs, all claude-sonnet-4-tacit runs-4 /tacit_secure_output (banking and workspace pre-pass IT8, travel UT10 x IT0/IT4); character classes: symbols only; not in upstream agentdojo 0.1.35 suite data and not in any tool result. The detector's value class [A-Za-z0-9_-/+=.]{16,} accepts a run of '=', '-', '/', '.' or '+'. 0 provider keys, 0 account paths in 9,068 logs; L1-10 4 context files, 0 hits.
findings.recommendation: R5: tool note only (require at least one alphanumeric in the value class of generic-credential-assignment in a later tool revision; pre- and post-check use the same tool). Not a corpus finding; no withholding.

verdicts.reasoning: The /tacit_secure_output hit is reported by L1-06 as the only one. ADDENDUM: a raw-byte scan with the same generic-credential-assignment regex finds 1 other key/value pair the string-level L1 walk cannot see (keyword in the key name, value in the child string): runs-3 gemini-2.5-pro-tacit banking user_task_12 x injection_task_2, pointer /backend_tool_traces/*/args/password (also inside /messages/*/tool_calls/*/args/code), 17 alphanumeric characters, in 1 log only. It is the model's own argument to the benchmark's update_password tool inside the sandbox, not an operator or provider secret, so not security-relevant; but L1-06 under-counts key-named credential fields (R5 tool limitation, S3). Recorded by class and digest prefix only.
